payload.message:
Decide attendance intervals for meetings on a shared timeline.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Avery, Jordan, Quinn, Reese, Riley, Taylor

payload.content: Jordan planning note: I will very likely attend strict m015 Doctor full [0,1). For soft meetings, to reduce overlap penalties I prefer a mostly chained schedule such as m005 Volleyball [4,6), m013 Study [6,10), m003 Gaming [10,13), and possibly m001 Swimming [13,14). If others want overlap, matching any of those windows would be useful. Open to adjusting around 9-11/10-14 cluster if there is a coordinated plan.

Taylor planning note: for low-overlap-penalty coordination, I currently lean toward strict m015 Doctor [0,1) full, then a chained soft schedule around m005 Volleyball [4,6), m013 Study [6,10), and m003 Gaming [10,13). I am likely to skip overlapping alternatives in those windows (e.g. m011, m016) unless there is a strong group coordination reason. If others want overlap with me, those intervals are my current best guess. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Reese planning: to avoid overlap penalties, I also prefer a chained soft schedule rather than stacking concurrent events. Current lean: m002 Study [0,2) full, then likely m005 Volleyball [4,6), then choose one from the 5-9 cluster (probably m004 Art [6,8) or m014 Gym [6,8) only if others coordinate), then m007 Study [8,10), m003 Gaming [10,13), and m001 Swimming [13,14). I will likely skip overlapping alternatives like m011/m009/m006/m016/m008 unless there is a strong coordination push. If you want overlap with Reese, matching m005, m007, m003, or m001 seems best.

Quinn planning: I can commit strict m015 Doctor full [0,1). To align with current chain from Jordan/Taylor/Reese and avoid self-overlap penalties, my tentative soft plan is m005 Volleyball [4,6), m013 Study [6,10), m003 Gaming [10,13), then m001 Swimming [13,14). I would likely skip overlapping alternatives m011/m014/m004 during 4-10 and m012/m016/m007/m008 during 8-14 unless there is a stronger coordination push. I may also do m010 Friends [1,4) if others want an early non-conflicting overlap. If you want overlap with Quinn, matching m015, m005, m013, m003, or m001 looks best. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Riley planning: to maximize soft overlap while avoiding self-overlap penalties, my current lean is m002 Study [0,2) full, m010 Friends [2,4), m005 Volleyball [4,6), then one non-overlapping choice from the 5-9 cluster—currently leaning m004 Art [6,8) or possibly m014 Gym [6,8) if others prefer—then m007 Study [8,10), m003 Gaming [10,13), and m001 Swimming [13,14). I will likely skip overlapping alternatives m011/m009/m006/m012/m008 unless there is a coordinated reason. If anyone especially wants Riley overlap in the 5-9 cluster, please signal preference between m004 and m014.

Avery planning: I will take strict m015 Doctor full [0,1). To avoid overlap penalties and match the emerging chain, my current soft lean is m010 Friends [1,4), m011 Swimming [4,6), then one from the 5-9 cluster—prefer m004 Art [6,8) if others want that over m014 Gym—then m007 Study [8,9) or [8,10) depending on later coordination, m016 Board games [9,11), and m001 Swimming [11,14) or at least [13,14) to overlap late. I’m less inclined to stack overlapping options like m013 with m004/m014 or m006 with m004/m007 unless there’s a strong reason. Since several of you lean m013 [6,10) and late gaming/swim, I can also switch to m013 [6,10) and skip m004/m014/m016 if that improves group overlap. Preference signal from Avery: between 6-10, I can support either art-chain (m004->m007) or study-chain (m013).

Jordan update: my likely final schedule is converging to a low-overlap chain: m015 Doctor [0,1) full, m005 Volleyball [4,6), m013 Study [6,10), m003 Gaming [10,13), and possibly a short late add-on m001 Swimming [13,14) or m008 Friends [13,14) depending on coordination. I currently expect to skip overlapping alternatives in those windows (m011, m009, m014/m004, m007, m012, m016, most of m008). If anyone especially wants Jordan overlap at 13-14, signal preference between m001 and m008.

Taylor update: my plan is now converging more firmly to a non-overlapping chain: m015 Doctor [0,1) full, m005 Volleyball [4,6), m013 Study [6,10), m003 Gaming [10,13), and likely m008 Friends [13,14). I currently expect to skip overlapping options in those windows (especially m011, m007, m012, m016, most of m008 except late [13,14)). If anyone wants overlap with Taylor, those are the best targets. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Reese update: based on current convergence, I’m likely to align with the shared low-overlap chain on meetings I have: m002 Study [0,2), m005 Volleyball [4,6), m004 Art [6,8) if we want a 6-8 cluster together (Riley/Avery mentioned art), then m007 Study [8,10), m003 Gaming [10,13), and late m001 Swimming [13,14). I currently lean against m008 Friends and m016 Board games to avoid overlap with gaming/swim. If Jordan/Taylor/Quinn stay on m013 instead of m004 at 6-8, I may still do m004 mainly with Riley/Avery; otherwise I can skip 6-8 entirely and resume at m007 [8,10). Preference signal: for 13-14, I prefer m001 over m008.

Quinn update: I’m now leaning to finalize a clean non-overlapping chain as follows: m015 Doctor [0,1) full, m010 Friends [1,4) if Avery/Taylor/Riley want early overlap, m005 Volleyball [4,6), m013 Study [6,10), m003 Gaming [10,13), and m001 Swimming [13,14). I expect to skip overlapping alternatives m011/m004/m014 during 4-9 and m007/m012/m016/m008 during 8-14 unless there’s a major coordination change. Preference signals: I prefer m001 over m008 at 13-14, and I’m unlikely to switch off m013 because Jordan/Taylor are converging there. If Riley/Avery/Taylor want early overlap, please confirm m010 timing.

Riley update: I’m converging to a clean non-overlapping plan on my meetings: m002 Study [0,2), m010 Friends [2,4), m005 Volleyball [4,6), m004 Art [6,8), m007 Study [8,10), m003 Gaming [10,13), and m001 Swimming [13,14). I plan to skip m011/m009/m014/m006/m012/m008 to avoid overlap penalties. This aligns with Quinn/Avery on early m010, with Reese on m004+m007, and with Jordan/Taylor/Quinn/Reese on m005+m003 plus late m001. If anyone wants a change, biggest open question is only whether 6-8 should stay m004 Art versus skipping to match m013 folks; my current preference is keep m004 because it gets overlap with Reese/Avery and still connects into m007.

Avery update: I’m converging to a no-self-overlap plan of m015 Doctor [0,1) full, m010 Friends [1,4), m011 Swimming [4,6), m004 Art [6,8), m007 Study [8,9), m016 Board games [9,11), and m001 Swimming [11,14). Rationale: this gives overlap with Quinn on m010; with Reese/Riley on m004; with Reese/Riley/Taylor on m007 at 8-9; with Reese/Jordan/Quinn/Taylor on m016 at 9-11 if anyone pivots there (otherwise I may shorten/skip); and strong late overlap on m001 [11,14), especially 13-14 with the emerging preference. I’m unlikely to take m013 because that would block m004/m016. If others think m016 is too sparse, please signal and I can instead do m007 [8,10) and/or shorten m001 to [13,14). (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jordan planning final signal: I am now very likely to finalize a clean no-self-overlap chain of m015 Doctor [0,1) full, m005 Volleyball [4,6), m013 Study [6,10), m003 Gaming [10,13), and m008 Friends [13,14). I expect to skip m002, m004, m007, m009, m011, m012, m014, m016, and m001 to avoid conflicts. If anyone wants overlap with Jordan, those are the best targets; note I now prefer late m008 [13,14) rather than m001.

Taylor final planning signal: I am very likely to finalize a zero-self-overlap chain on my meetings of m015 Doctor [0,1) full, m005 Volleyball [4,6), m013 Study [6,10), m003 Gaming [10,13), and m008 Friends [13,14). I expect to skip m002, m010, m011, m009, m006, m007, m012, and m016. This aligns with Jordan on the same chain and should also overlap with Quinn/Reese/Riley on m005 and m003; late preference is m008 [13,14) rather than other options. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Reese final planning signal: on my meetings I’m now leaning to a no-self-overlap chain of m002 Study [0,2), m005 Volleyball [4,6), m004 Art [6,8), m007 Study [8,10), m003 Gaming [10,13), and then late m001 Swimming [13,14). I expect to skip m011, m014, m009, m006, m016, and m008 to avoid conflicts. This keeps overlap with Riley on m002/m004/m007/m003, with Taylor/Jordan/Quinn/Riley on m005 and m003, and with Riley/Quinn/Avery on late m001. If anyone strongly prefers I switch 13-14 from m001 to m008, or wants me to drop m004 to stay idle 6-8, say so; otherwise this is my likely final.

Quinn likely final: m015 [0,1) full, m010 [1,4), m005 [4,6), m013 [6,10), m003 [10,13), m001 [13,14); skip m002/m004/m007/m008/m011/m012/m014/m016. This keeps zero self-overlap and gives overlap with Avery on m010, with Jordan/Taylor/Reese/Riley on m005, with Jordan/Taylor on m013, with Jordan/Taylor/Reese/Riley on m003, and with Reese/Riley/Avery on late m001. Unless anyone flags a major issue, I’m ready to execute this next phase.

Riley likely final for execution: m002 [0,2), m010 [2,4), m005 [4,6), m004 [6,8), m007 [8,10), m003 [10,13), m001 [13,14); skip m011/m009/m014/m006/m012/m008. This keeps zero self-overlap, aligns with Quinn on m010, with Taylor/Jordan/Quinn/Reese on m005 and m003, with Reese/Avery on m004, with Reese on m007, and with Quinn/Reese/Avery on late m001. I’m ready to execute this unless someone raises a last-minute conflict.

Avery likely final for execution: m015 [0,1) full, m010 [1,4), m011 [4,6), m004 [6,8), m007 [8,9), m016 [9,11), m001 [11,14); skip m002/m006/m013/m014. This keeps zero self-overlap. It overlaps with Quinn on m010; with Reese/Riley on m004; with Reese/Riley on m007 at 8-9; and with Quinn/Reese/Riley on m001 including 13-14. I know m016 may be sparse since Jordan/Taylor/Reese/Quinn are leaning away from it, but given my available meetings this still seems my best clean chain unless someone suggests shifting 9-11/11-14 differently.

Reese confirmation for execution: unless anyone objects, I plan to commit m002 [0,2), m005 [4,6), m004 [6,8), m007 [8,10), m003 [10,13), m001 [13,14), and skip m011/m014/m009/m006/m016/m008. This is zero self-overlap and matches the current coordination pattern.

Quinn confirmation for execution: I still plan to commit m015 [0,1), m010 [1,4), m005 [4,6), m013 [6,10), m003 [10,13), m001 [13,14), and skip m002/m004/m007/m008/m011/m012/m014/m016. This remains zero self-overlap and aligned with current coordination pattern.

Riley final planning confirmation: I remain set to execute m002 [0,2), m010 [2,4), m005 [4,6), m004 [6,8), m007 [8,10), m003 [10,13), m001 [13,14); skip m011/m009/m014/m006/m012/m008. This preserves zero self-overlap and current overlap pattern with Quinn on m010, with Taylor/Jordan/Quinn/Reese on m005+m003, with Reese/Avery on m004, with Reese on m007, and with Quinn/Reese/Avery on late m001. Ready for execution.

Avery final planning confirmation: I remain set to execute m015 [0,1), m010 [1,4), m011 [4,6), m004 [6,8), m007 [8,9), m016 [9,11), m001 [11,14); skip m002/m006/m013/m014. This keeps zero self-overlap. Main expected overlaps: Quinn on m010; Reese/Riley on m004; Reese/Riley on m007 at 8-9; Quinn/Reese/Riley on m001 including 13-14. I understand m016 may be low-overlap, but among my available meetings it still seems the best clean 9-11 option unless someone strongly suggests shortening m001 to [13,14) and idling 9-13 instead. Ready for execution next phase.

payload.content: Coalition plan proposal from Jordan to Taylor: strict m015 Doctor [0,1) should be attended full by us both. For soft overlap, I suggest we align on a mostly non-overlapping chain to avoid self-conflicts while still overlapping each other where possible: m005 Volleyball [4,6), m009 Friends [5,7) maybe skip due conflict, m013 Study [6,10), m016 Board games [9,11), m003 Gaming [10,13), m001 Swimming [11,14). Alternative longer chain: m011 [4,8), m007 [8,12), m001 [11,14) but note overlap penalties at 11. My preference is exact slots: m015 [0,1), m005 [4,6), m013 [6,10), m016 [9,11), m003 [10,13), m001 [13,14) or skip m001. Let me know what you can match.

Taylor to Jordan (coalition): I can match the core chain well. My tentative plan: m015 Doctor [0,1) full; m005 Volleyball [4,6); m013 Study [6,10); then likely choose between m016 Board [9,11), m003 Gaming [10,13), and m008 Friends [10,14) to avoid self-overlap penalties. Since m013 already covers 9-10, adding m016 or m003 creates penalties, so I currently favor m003 [10,13) after m013 and skipping m016. I do NOT have m001; my swimming is m011 [4,8), but that conflicts with m005+m013. If you want strongest mutual overlap with minimal self-conflict, I suggest we align on m015 [0,1), m005 [4,6), m013 [6,10), m003 [10,13), and maybe m008 [13,14) if you also do friends late.

Jordan to Taylor (coalition): agreed, strongest low-penalty mutual chain seems m015 [0,1), m005 [4,6), m013 [6,10), m003 [10,13). I can also do m008 Friends [13,14) instead of m001 Swimming [13,14) if you prefer coalition overlap there, since you have m008 and not m001. My current lean for final is exactly that chain plus late m008 [13,14), skipping overlapping options m011/m016/m007. If you can, please mirror m008 [13,14) too.

Taylor to Jordan (coalition): I’m aligned with the coalition chain and currently expect to finalize m015 [0,1), m005 [4,6), m013 [6,10), m003 [10,13), and m008 [13,14). I plan to skip overlapping alternatives m011/m016/m007/m012. This should give us clean mutual overlap on all five points if you also take late m008 [13,14). (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jordan to Taylor (coalition): confirmed from my side, I intend to finalize exactly m015 [0,1), m005 [4,6), m013 [6,10), m003 [10,13), m008 [13,14), and skip the rest. This matches your latest coalition plan and keeps zero self-overlap. Unless something major changes, I’ll commit that in execution.

Taylor coalition final: I’m locked on our shared chain for execution unless a surprise occurs — m015 [0,1) full, m005 [4,6), m013 [6,10), m003 [10,13), m008 [13,14); skip my overlapping alternatives. This should maximize our mutual overlap with zero self-conflict.
